summary.en: OSTIn (Office for Space Technology & Industry), set up in 2013 and folded into the new National Space Agency of Singapore (NSAS) in 2026, is Singapore's national space office. It runs the Space Technology Development Programme (STDP) - launched in 2022 with S$150M and topped up by S$60M in 2024 - offering non-dilutive R&D grants and a Space Access Programme for in-orbit technology demonstration across remote sensing, satellite comms and in-space manufacturing.
